item: The consent ratchet's scan reaches one hop, and the routes it finds join the table: two more defects pinned (source preflight, RSS discovery)
refs: PR pending; R300 item 1; follows PR #1542
summary: The scan of src/api now reaches EXACTLY one hop: a handler that calls a function which itself names a fetch primitive, resolved through an import from a src module or a function in its own file (never a bare method name), plus guarded_session as a primitive. Rows record how they are found (direct, hop, hand); a hand row must stay invisible to the scan, so a scan that learns to see it forces the row to be reclassified, and a test pins that the governments load and the stats fetch (two hops) are NOT found. New rows: consent for the weather context, the stats figures fetch, the governments load, the Wikidata items fetch and the three discovery jobs (each client awaits ensureOnline before its request); named for the hazards relay, the signals hazards snapshot and resolve-qid-names (each proved by a real refusal); and two GAP rows for defects the work found: POST /api/sources/preflight in airplane mode records every enabled source as unreachable, writes the preflight log (which marks the first-run preflight done) and lists the sources under unreachable, and POST /api/sources/discover/rss answers Discovered RSS feeds for 0 sources for sources it never asked about. Both are pinned as they behave today and proposed as their own fix PRs (R189). Stated limits: two-hop and method-on-object fetchers stay invisible; the wiki-dump, OSM-download and AI-install managers are not in the table. Mutants: a consent call removed, a new hop route, the hop branches disabled, and a gap fixed all fail the right test.
